method: Visual crown interpretation from unlabelled 2026 RGB/CIR and 2024 CHM; pixel coordinates on 400 x 400 CHM panels at 4 pixels per metre. Frozen before fresh detector outputs are viewed.
limits: Source-relative approximate crown centres, not surveyed trunks.
Fresh scenes do not overlap round-one reference areas.
Dense or clipped crowns are excluded using manually declared regions, before predictions.
Low-height vegetation and image-only apparent crowns remain unresolved.
The sample is purposive and does not establish course-wide accuracy.
